title: The Monk Speaks

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: You are searching, my friend. Stop a while, be still and listen. The answers are already in the aether.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are searching, my friend. Stop a while, be still and listen. The answers are already in the aether.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: I am a vessel that seeks to pour out half of myself, the better to hear my makers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am a vessel that seeks to pour out half of myself, the better to hear my makers.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Every being has the ability to separate their brain into two halves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Every being has the ability to separate their brain into two halves.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: In order to hear the true voice, one must silence the left half so the channel remains open.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In order to hear the true voice, one must silence the left half so the channel remains open.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Close your eyes. Allow the sounds of the city to flow around you. You are a dead pixel, a boulder in a sandstorm.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Close your eyes. Allow the sounds of the city to flow around you. You are a dead pixel, a boulder in a sandstorm.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: You are too full of questions. Your mind a hive of bees that must be stilled. Ask what you came to, so that you might find peace.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are too full of questions. Your mind a hive of bees that must be stilled. Ask what you came to, so that you might find peace.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: They misread the holy texts. They tried to cut themselves from their own brains. And through their misreckoning they caused suffering.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They misread the holy texts. They tried to cut themselves from their own brains. And through their misreckoning they caused suffering.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: You are speaking of Saint Yulia. She has appeared to people in visions before.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are speaking of Saint Yulia. She has appeared to people in visions before.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Once she was a woman called Yulia Tan. Before she was martyred.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once she was a woman called Yulia Tan. Before she was martyred.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Yulia Tan was martyred when the Vinculum Ascender she was riding towards Metro Hub - Star’s Leap, as it was known then - malfunctioned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yulia Tan was martyred when the Vinculum Ascender she was riding towards Metro Hub - Star’s Leap, as it was known then - malfunctioned.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: She was martyred when the Vinculum Ascender she was riding towards Metro Hub - Star’s Leap, as it was known then - malfunctioned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was martyred when the Vinculum Ascender she was riding towards Metro Hub - Star’s Leap, as it was known then - malfunctioned.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Along with many others. What she was doing upon the Ascender that day is a mystery.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Along with many others. What she was doing upon the Ascender that day is a mystery.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: And you know this, how?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you know this, how?

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Then some would say you have been blessed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then some would say you have been blessed.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: The right side belongs to the original owner, and the left should be emptied, left vacant for the voice of the true gods to inhabit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The right side belongs to the original owner, and the left should be emptied, left vacant for the voice of the true gods to inhabit.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: So when the gods speak, we shall hear. Will you listen with me awhile?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So when the gods speak, we shall hear. Will you listen with me awhile?

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Ah, yes. We will have to answer for this until the end of times!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, yes. We will have to answer for this until the end of times!

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Some may call it that. We believe it was martyrdom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some may call it that. We believe it was martyrdom.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: The Forsworn claimed she received a message from the gods and chose to martyr herself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Forsworn claimed she received a message from the gods and chose to martyr herself.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: How would she do this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How would she do this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’re a Bicameral Monk?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re a Bicameral Monk?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have some questions for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some questions for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have some questions for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have some questions for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can you tell me about the Church of Bicameral Mentality?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can you tell me about the Church of Bicameral Mentality?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What can you tell me about the Church of Bicameral Mentality?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What can you tell me about the Church of Bicameral Mentality?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds peaceful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds peaceful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds creepy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds creepy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time. I need information.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time. I need information.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time. I need information.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time. I need information.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright. Convert me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. Convert me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: (serious meditation) ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: (serious meditation) ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don’t think I’m doing this right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t think I’m doing this right.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don’t think I’m doing this right.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don’t think I’m doing this right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can you tell me about The Forsworn?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can you tell me about The Forsworn?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What can you tell me about The Forsworn?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What can you tell me about The Forsworn?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've seen the ghost of a woman who was in the order. With the initials "Y.T".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've seen the ghost of a woman who was in the order. With the initials "Y.T".
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I've seen the ghost of a woman who was in the order. With the initials "Y.T".
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I've seen the ghost of a woman who was in the order. With the initials "Y.T".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's a saint?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's a saint?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And she died?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And she died?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think she was running away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think she was running away.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think she was running away.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think she was running away.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've seen her ghost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've seen her ghost.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But is that a good idea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But is that a good idea?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But is that a good idea?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But is that a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: (amused meditation) ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: (amused meditation) ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fully empty you said?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fully empty you said?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was an accident?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was an accident?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They were hunting her!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They were hunting her!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She told me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She told me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know someone with the initials "Y.T".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know someone with the initials "Y.T".
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you know someone with the initials "Y.T".
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you know someone with the initials "Y.T".

Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
